data.name: Ash Frontier Survival
data.detailed_description:
Survive, build, and thrive in a rugged Wild West frontier surrounded by dense forests and a quiet lake where you can fish, hunt, and live off the land. Every sunrise, storm, and gunfight can change your fate.

Craft your own destiny as a lone drifter or a frontier settler in a living open world full of danger and opportunity. Build your base, farm the land, hunt wildlife, mine for resources, and trade with voiced NPCs and shop vendors in dusty woodland towns.

But whispers tell of something unnatural hidden among the trees — a clockwork outlaw, a mechanical legend with a bounty on its head and rare rewards for those brave enough to hunt it down.

Ride your horse through forest trails, explore dangerous mines, team up with friends in multiplayer, and grow your skills to survive the unforgiving frontier.

🧰 Features

  • 🏕️ Open-world survival — Explore a handcrafted Wild West frontier filled with forests, lakes, and dusty towns.

  • 🪓 Base building & crafting — Build your home, craft tools, and upgrade gear at crafting benches.

  • 🌾 Farming & gathering — Grow crops, harvest resources, and live off the land.

  • 👕 Clothing system — Find, craft, and equip a variety of clothing pieces for protection and style, from dusty coats to outlaw scarves and hats.

  • 🐎 Horses & travel — Tame and ride horses across the open world.

  • 🐻 Wildlife & hunting — Track, hunt, and skin animals for food and materials.

  • 🎣 Fishing & swimming — Relax by the lake or dive in to explore.

  • 🧱 Mining & resource collection — Mine rocks, chop trees, and refine materials.

  • 🧭 Dynamic world — Full day–night cycle, dynamic weather, and seasonal atmosphere.

  • 🤝 Multiplayer — Team up with friends to explore, trade, and survive together.

  • 🗺️ Progression systems — Leveling, map exploration, and save system support.

  • 🏪 Vendors & NPCs — Trade goods, accept bounties, and uncover local stories.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card with DirectX 12 support

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes depictions of violence, blood, and visible bodies after combat. Players can hunt and kill animals for resources. Some healing items reference historical substances such as cocaine and opium. The player character begins the game wearing only underwear. Online play may expose players to unmoderated chat.
